# Data preparation

## Script to get distribution of number of orthogroups with different numbers of genes

Just for orthogroups with all species present.

```{sh}
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/
mkdir phylo_tree
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree
mkdir input_orthogroups

GENECOUNT="../orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.GeneCount.tsv"

awk '
BEGIN { FS="\t" }

NR > 1 {
    all_present = 1

    for (i = 2; i <= NF - 1; i++) {
        if ($i == 0) {
            all_present = 0
            break
        }
    }

    if (all_present)
        print $NF
}
' ${GENECOUNT} |
sort -n |
uniq -c
```

```{sh}
GENECOUNT="../orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.GeneCount.tsv"
MAX_GENES=30

OUT_PREFIX="input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max${MAX_GENES}"

echo "Input file: ${GENECOUNT}"
echo "Maximum number of genes per orthogroup: ${MAX_GENES}"
echo

# Overwrite existing output files
> "${OUT_PREFIX}.tsv"
> "${OUT_PREFIX}.ids.txt"

awk -v maxgenes="$MAX_GENES" \
    -v outfile="${OUT_PREFIX}.tsv" \
    -v idfile="${OUT_PREFIX}.ids.txt" '
BEGIN {
    FS = OFS = "\t"
}

NR == 1 {
    # OrthoFinder GeneCount table:
    # column 1 = Orthogroup
    # columns 2...(NF-1) = species
    # last column = Total

    nspecies = NF - 2

    print "Number of species detected:", nspecies > "/dev/stderr"

    print $0 >> outfile
    next
}

{
    all_present = 1

    # Check whether every species has at least one gene
    for (i = 2; i <= NF - 1; i++) {
        if ($i == 0) {
            all_present = 0
            break
        }
    }

    total_genes = $NF

    if (all_present) {
        complete++

        if (total_genes <= maxgenes) {
            retained++
            print $0 >> outfile
            print $1 >> idfile
        }
    }
}

END {
    print ""
    print "Summary:"
    print "Complete orthogroups (all species present):", complete
    print "Complete orthogroups with <=", maxgenes, "genes:", retained
}
' "$GENECOUNT"

echo
echo "Output files:"
echo "  ${OUT_PREFIX}.tsv"
echo "  ${OUT_PREFIX}.ids.txt"

```

## Add species names to protein names in fasta files before alignment

Just for orthogroups that will be used for alignment.
```{sh}
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree


############################
# User-defined variables
############################

# OrthoFinder table with genes separated by species
ORTHOGROUPS_TSV="../orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.tsv"

# Original OrthoFinder orthogroup FASTA files
INPUT_DIR="../orthofinder_results/Results_brassicaceae_3/Orthogroup_Sequences"

# Selected orthogroups
ORTHOGROUP_LIST="input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max30.ids.txt"

# Output directory for renamed FASTA files
OUTPUT_DIR="input_orthogroups/renamed_fastas"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Starting FASTA header renaming"
echo "Orthogroups table:  $ORTHOGROUPS_TSV"
echo "Orthogroup list:    $ORTHOGROUP_LIST"
echo "Input directory:    $INPUT_DIR"
echo "Output directory:   $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo

############################
# Rename FASTA headers
############################

awk \
    -v input_dir="$INPUT_DIR" \
    -v output_dir="$OUTPUT_DIR" '
    
BEGIN {
    FS = OFS = "\t"
}

################################
# First input: selected OG IDs
################################

ARGIND == 1 {

    # Remove possible Windows carriage return
    gsub(/\r/, "")

    if ($1 != "")
        selected[$1] = 1

    next
}

################################
# Second input: Orthogroups.tsv
################################

ARGIND == 2 && FNR == 1 {

    # Store species names from header
    for (i = 2; i <= NF; i++) {

        species[i] = $i

        # Remove Windows carriage returns
        gsub(/\r/, "", species[i])

        # Replace spaces with underscores
        gsub(/ /, "_", species[i])
    }

    next
}

ARGIND == 2 {

    og = $1

    # Ignore orthogroups that were not selected
    if (!(og in selected))
        next

    print "Processing: " og > "/dev/stderr"

    ################################
    # Build map only for this OG
    ################################

    delete gene_species

    for (i = 2; i <= NF; i++) {

        field = $i

        # Remove Windows carriage returns
        gsub(/\r/, "", field)

        if (field == "")
            continue

        # Multiple genes in one species are comma-separated
        n = split(field, genes, ", ")

        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {

            gene = genes[j]
            gsub(/\r/, "", gene)

            gene_species[gene] = species[i]
        }
    }

    ################################
    # Rename corresponding FASTA
    ################################

    infile  = input_dir "/" og ".fa"
    outfile = output_dir "/" og ".fa"

    # Make sure an existing output is overwritten
    printf "" > outfile
    close(outfile)

    found_fasta = 0

    while ((getline line < infile) > 0) {

        found_fasta = 1

        if (line ~ /^>/) {

            header = substr(line, 2)
            gsub(/\r/, "", header)

            # Original gene ID = first whitespace-delimited field
            split(header, x, /[[:space:]]+/)
            gene = x[1]

            if (gene in gene_species) {
                print ">" gene_species[gene] "|" gene >> outfile
            }
            else {
                print ">" gene >> outfile
                print "WARNING: Species not found for gene " gene \
                    " in " og > "/dev/stderr"
            }
        }
        else {
            gsub(/\r/, "", line)
            print line >> outfile
        }
    }

    close(infile)
    close(outfile)

    if (!found_fasta)
        print "WARNING: FASTA file not found or empty: " infile \
            > "/dev/stderr"

    processed[og] = 1
}

END {

    n_selected = 0
    n_processed = 0

    for (og in selected) {
        n_selected++

        if (og in processed)
            n_processed++
        else
            print "WARNING: Selected orthogroup not found in Orthogroups.tsv: " og \
                > "/dev/stderr"
    }

    print ""
    print "Summary:"
    print "Selected orthogroups:", n_selected
    print "Processed orthogroups:", n_processed
}

' "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST" "$ORTHOGROUPS_TSV"

echo
echo "Finished."
echo "Renamed FASTA files:"
echo "  $OUTPUT_DIR"
```


# MAFFT alignment of orthogroups

```{sh}
### Metacentrum script

#!/bin/bash
#PBS -N mafft_orthogroups
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=16:mem=8gb:scratch_local=10gb
#PBS -l walltime=1:00:00
#PBS -m ae

set -euo pipefail

############################
# User-defined variables
############################

# Directory with OrthoFinder orthogroup FASTA files
INPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/input_orthogroups/renamed_fastas"

# File containing selected orthogroup IDs, one per line
ORTHOGROUP_LIST="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max30.ids.txt"

# Directory for MAFFT alignments
OUTPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/mafft_alignments"

# Number of parallel MAFFT jobs
NCPU=16

############################
# Environment
############################

module load mafft

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

cd "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Starting MAFFT alignments"
echo "Input directory:    $INPUT_DIR"
echo "Orthogroup list:    $ORTHOGROUP_LIST"
echo "Output directory:   $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo "Parallel jobs:      $NCPU"
echo "Start time:         $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"
echo "MAFFT version:"
mafft --version 2>&1
echo

############################
# Alignment function
############################

align_one() {

    og="$1"

    # Remove possible Windows carriage returns
    og="${og//$'\r'/}"

    # Skip empty lines
    [[ -z "$og" ]] && return

    infile="${INPUT_DIR}/${og}.fa"
    outfile="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${og}.aln.fa"

    # Check whether the input file exists
    if [[ ! -f "$infile" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Input file not found: $infile" >&2
        return
    fi

    # Skip already completed alignments
    if [[ -s "$outfile" ]]; then
        echo "Skipping existing alignment: $og"
        return
    fi

    echo "Aligning: $og"

    mafft \
        --auto \
        --thread 1 \
        "$infile" \
        > "$outfile"
}

export -f align_one
export INPUT_DIR
export OUTPUT_DIR

############################
# Run selected orthogroups
############################

grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST" |
    xargs -n 1 -P "$NCPU" bash -c 'align_one "$1"' _

############################
# Summary
############################

N_SELECTED=$(grep -cv '^[[:space:]]*$' "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST")

N_OUTPUT=$(find "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    -maxdepth 1 \
    -type f \
    -name "*.aln.fa" \
    -size +0c |
    wc -l)

echo
echo "MAFFT alignment finished"
echo "Selected orthogroups: $N_SELECTED"
echo "Completed alignments: $N_OUTPUT"
echo "End time:             $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"

# clean the SCRATCH directory
clean_scratch

# Resources:
# With 32 CPUs: Just 4 min, 0,87 GB memory, 76 % CPU
# With 16 CPUs: Just 6,5 min, 0,67 GB memory, 83 % CPU
```

```{sh}
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/metacentrum_scripts
qsub mafft_orthogroups.bash
```

# IQ-TREE calculation of trees for each orthogroup

Model is selected manually as `-m LG+G4` to get fast calculation.

```{sh}
### Metacentrum script

#!/bin/bash
#PBS -N iqtree_gene_trees
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=16:mem=64gb:scratch_local=10gb
#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00
#PBS -m ae

set -euo pipefail

############################
# User-defined variables
############################

# Directory with MAFFT alignments
INPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/mafft_alignments"

# File containing selected orthogroup IDs, one per line
ORTHOGROUP_LIST="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max30.ids.txt"

# Directory for IQ-TREE results
OUTPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/iqtree_gene_trees"

# Number of parallel IQ-TREE jobs
NCPU=16

# Batch size
BATCH_SIZE=500

# Batch number.
# Can be supplied using:
# qsub -v BATCH=3 iqtree_gene_trees.sh
#
# If BATCH is not supplied, batch 1 is used.
BATCH="${BATCH:-1}"

############################
# Calculate batch range
############################

START=$(( (BATCH - 1) * BATCH_SIZE + 1 ))
END=$(( BATCH * BATCH_SIZE ))

############################
# Environment
############################

module load iqtree

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

cd "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Starting IQ-TREE gene tree inference"
echo "Input directory:    $INPUT_DIR"
echo "Orthogroup list:    $ORTHOGROUP_LIST"
echo "Output directory:   $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo "Batch:              $BATCH"
echo "Batch range:        $START-$END"
echo "Parallel jobs:      $NCPU"
echo "Start time:         $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"
echo "IQ-TREE version:"
iqtree3-mpi --version 2>&1
echo

############################
# Prepare batch list
############################

BATCH_LIST="${SCRATCHDIR}/orthogroups_batch_${BATCH}.txt"

grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST" |
    sed -n "${START},${END}p" \
    > "$BATCH_LIST"

N_SELECTED=$(wc -l < "$BATCH_LIST")

echo "Orthogroups in this batch: $N_SELECTED"
echo

if [[ "$N_SELECTED" -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "No orthogroups found for batch $BATCH."
    clean_scratch
    exit 0
fi

############################
# Gene tree function
############################

tree_one() {

    og="$1"

    # Remove possible Windows carriage returns
    og="${og//$'\r'/}"

    # Skip empty lines
    [[ -z "$og" ]] && return

    infile="${INPUT_DIR}/${og}.aln.fa"
    prefix="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${og}"

    # Check whether the input alignment exists
    if [[ ! -f "$infile" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Input alignment not found: $infile" >&2
        return
    fi

    # Skip already completed trees
    if [[ -s "${prefix}.treefile" ]]; then
        echo "Skipping existing tree: $og"
        return
    fi

    echo "Inferring tree: $og"

    iqtree3-mpi \
        -s "$infile" \
        -m LG+G4 \
        -T 1 \
        --prefix "$prefix" \
        --quiet
}

export -f tree_one
export INPUT_DIR
export OUTPUT_DIR

############################
# Run orthogroups in batch
############################

xargs -n 1 -P "$NCPU" \
    bash -c 'tree_one "$1"' _ \
    < "$BATCH_LIST"

############################
# Summary
############################

N_OUTPUT=0

while read -r og; do

    og="${og//$'\r'/}"

    if [[ -s "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${og}.treefile" ]]; then
        ((N_OUTPUT+=1))
    fi

done < "$BATCH_LIST"

echo
echo "IQ-TREE gene tree inference finished"
echo "Batch:                 $BATCH"
echo "Orthogroups in batch:  $N_SELECTED"
echo "Completed trees:       $N_OUTPUT"
echo "End time:              $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"

clean_scratch

# Resources:
# 500 OG on 16 CPUs: ~ 23 min, 95 % CPU, 0.54 GB memory

```

Run in several batches to get faster calculation.

```{sh}
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/metacentrum_scripts

for i in {1..11}; do
    qsub -v BATCH="$i" iqtree_gene_trees.bash
done
```


# Tree pruning with OrthoSNAP

## Testing
```{sh}
cd /storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree

# Directory with MAFFT alignments
ALIGN_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/mafft_alignments"

# Directory with IQ-TREE gene trees
TREE_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/iqtree_gene_trees"

# File containing selected orthogroup IDs
ORTHOGROUP_LIST="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max30.ids.txt"

# Output directory
OUTPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/orthosnap_testing"

# OrthoSNAP virtual environment
ORTHOSNAP_ENV="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/SW/orthosnap_env"

# Number of species required in retained SNAP-OGs
N_SPECIES=23


module load python
source "${ORTHOSNAP_ENV}/bin/activate"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"


MANIFEST="${OUTPUT_DIR}/orthosnap_manifest_test.tsv"

printf "fasta\ttree\n" > "$MANIFEST"

N_INPUT=0
N_MISSING=0

while read -r og; do

    og="${og//$'\r'/}"
    [[ -z "$og" ]] && continue

    fasta="${ALIGN_DIR}/${og}.aln.fa"
    tree="${TREE_DIR}/${og}.treefile"

    if [[ ! -f "$fasta" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Missing alignment: $fasta" >&2
        ((N_MISSING+=1))
        continue
    fi

    if [[ ! -f "$tree" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Missing tree: $tree" >&2
        ((N_MISSING+=1))
        continue
    fi

    printf "%s\t%s\n" "$fasta" "$tree" >> "$MANIFEST"
    ((N_INPUT+=1))

done < <(head -n 10 "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST")

echo "Valid orthogroups in manifest: $N_INPUT"
echo "Missing inputs:                $N_MISSING"
echo

############################
# Run OrthoSNAP
############################

orthosnap \
    --manifest "$MANIFEST" \
    --occupancy-count "$N_SPECIES" \
    --support 0 \
    --structured-output \
    -op "$OUTPUT_DIR"
    
orthosnap \
    --manifest "$MANIFEST" \
    --support 0 \
    --structured-output \
    -op "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --plot_snap_ogs
    
```


```{sh}
#!/bin/bash
#PBS -N orthosnap_pruning
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=8:mem=32gb:scratch_local=10gb
#PBS -l walltime=24:00:00
#PBS -m ae

set -euo pipefail

############################
# User-defined variables
############################

# Directory with MAFFT alignments
ALIGN_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/mafft_alignments"

# Directory with IQ-TREE gene trees
TREE_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/iqtree_gene_trees"

# File containing selected orthogroup IDs
ORTHOGROUP_LIST="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/input_orthogroups/complete_orthogroups_max30.ids.txt"

# Output directory
OUTPUT_DIR="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/Brassicaceae_orthology/brassicaceae_3/phylo_tree/orthosnap_pruned_trees"

# OrthoSNAP virtual environment
ORTHOSNAP_ENV="/storage/brno12-cerit/home/duchmil/SW/orthosnap_env"

# Number of species required in retained SNAP-OGs
N_SPECIES=23

############################
# Environment
############################

module load python
source "${ORTHOSNAP_ENV}/bin/activate"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "Starting OrthoSNAP pruning"
echo "Alignment directory: $ALIGN_DIR"
echo "Tree directory:      $TREE_DIR"
echo "Orthogroup list:     $ORTHOGROUP_LIST"
echo "Output directory:    $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo "Required species:    $N_SPECIES"
echo "Start time:          $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"
echo
echo "OrthoSNAP version:"
orthosnap --version 2>&1
echo

############################
# Create manifest
############################

MANIFEST="${SCRATCHDIR}/orthosnap_manifest.tsv"

printf "fasta\ttree\n" > "$MANIFEST"

N_INPUT=0
N_MISSING=0

while read -r og; do

    og="${og//$'\r'/}"
    [[ -z "$og" ]] && continue

    fasta="${ALIGN_DIR}/${og}.aln.fa"
    tree="${TREE_DIR}/${og}.treefile"

    if [[ ! -f "$fasta" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Missing alignment: $fasta" >&2
        ((N_MISSING+=1))
        continue
    fi

    if [[ ! -f "$tree" ]]; then
        echo "WARNING: Missing tree: $tree" >&2
        ((N_MISSING+=1))
        continue
    fi

    printf "%s\t%s\n" "$fasta" "$tree" >> "$MANIFEST"
    ((N_INPUT+=1))

done < "$ORTHOGROUP_LIST"

echo "Valid orthogroups in manifest: $N_INPUT"
echo "Missing inputs:                $N_MISSING"
echo

############################
# Run OrthoSNAP
############################

orthosnap \
    --manifest "$MANIFEST" \
    --occupancy-count "$N_SPECIES" \
    --structured-output \
    -op "$OUTPUT_DIR"

############################
# Summary
############################

echo
echo "OrthoSNAP pruning finished"
echo "Input orthogroups: $N_INPUT"
echo "End time:          $(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")"

deactivate

clean_scratch

```
